scope: Runtime IncludeFiles of a one-row task-local Access MDB with required BASE-01 Station, while the main SXI retains K02-NAMED Station and other accepted K02 rows.

dependency.behavior_specific_limit: K02 established its named Station CLI JSON slice only; K05 tests database runtime include.

manual.rule: IncludeFiles.INCFN accepts an MDB through its default Access ODBC association and merges same-name input tables at calculation. Full path avoids current-directory dependence.

frozen_commands: create task-local MDB with x86 Jet
temporarily map MDB to the installed 64-bit Access driver during calculation and restore the prior association
acceptance_hypotheses: The MDB has exactly one Station table and one authored BASE-01 row, confirmed via x86 ODBC readback and sealed SHA-256.
The main SXI retains its sole IncludeFiles row and its other authored rows.
Calculation loads the MDB BASE-01 Station with zero converter errors and produces a usable SXO and report.
Native events and report are byte-identical to accepted K02.var01 named baseline; the source-row union equals K02 except IncludeFiles.
gate: Any missing include, wrong path, row mismatch, converter error, unusable result, unexplained behavior difference, GUI change or source fingerprint change is NO-GO.
limitations: This candidate depends on a guarded, temporary per-user MDB driver association; the earlier unmodified mapping pointed to a missing 64-bit ODBC driver. It does not establish ODBC editor import/export, aliases, nulls, invalid values, nested or relative includes, or full K04/K05 coverage.
